title: 第十五章 诸侯攻关
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
“盟主，那吕布整天在关外挑衅，却不思进取，听说还夜夜宴请各路诸侯将领，恐怕是不想攻关啊。”诸侯大帐，袁术不忘给前方的吕布上眼药。
“哼，汜水关易守难攻，关内守城器械精良，强攻无异于送死，我军新败士气低落，吕将军作战有功，岂容你胡言乱语。”孙坚冷哼道，他现在对袁家两兄弟有些失望，自从会盟之后，诸侯在一起就是吃吃喝喝，不思进取。
“吕将军斩杀董贼大将，功不可没。”公孙瓒也附声道。
“众将听令，整备兵马，克日攻打汜水关，不破此关，誓不罢休。”袁绍下定决心道，将吕布派上去也是为了消耗并州军的兵力，而董卓此举，定会让诸侯惶恐，再不进攻，恐会失众人之心。
“诺。”各路诸侯齐声道。
三日后，袁军上下身披缟素，袁绍大手一挥“杀！”
隆隆的鼓声刺激着每一名联军士兵的心脏，面对雄关和未知死亡的恐惧似乎在鼓声中消散。
随着传令兵一道道命令传下去，十余万诸侯联军运行了起来，一架架云梯被士卒扛着急速向城墙处冲去，面对如同飞蝗一般的箭矢，人的性命是那么的不值钱，大多数士兵永远的倒在了前进的路上。
受伤的士兵，根本无法撤退，他们的哀嚎声，在偌大的战场上是那么的微弱，只能眼睁睁的看着后方鱼涌而来的士兵，无奈的倒在了人海中。
身处中军的吕布，再次感觉到了冷兵器战争的残酷，尤其是在汜水关这样的雄关面前，若想攻破，需要的是士兵的鲜血和尸体堆积出一条通往关内的通道。
这与之前和董卓在野外交战不同，关内的守军依仗城高墙厚，不停的搭弓射箭，檑木滚石不要命的倾泻，许多士兵甚至连敌人长什么样都不知道就永远的倒下了，这种时候，就算是武艺高强的将领，也不敢说会在这样的攻城中独善其身，一人的力量始终是有限的。
看着一名名倒下的并州军士卒，吕布感觉自己的心在滴血，他将这些袍泽当做兄弟，可以生死依靠的人，没想到转眼之间生死两隔。
“盟主，汜水关内有五万援军，且董卓老贼就在关内，一时间难以攻克。”吕布劝道。
“无需多言，不破此关，誓不罢休！”袁绍一脸决绝的说道。
盟军大部分是没有经过训练的士卒，大多数人或许是刚刚放下农具拿起兵器，面对袍泽一茬一茬的死亡，许多人害怕了，扔掉兵器试图逃离这个人间地狱，可迎接他们的却是督战将领的箭矢。
一日下来，关下的尸体堆积如山，城墙上满是鲜血，汜水关的关门也有些变形。
“盟主，今日一战，联军共损失兵马八千多人，重伤四千多人，轻伤不计其数。”负责统计的将领的将数目报上之后，吕布倒吸一口冷气，一天就死了八千多，这可是两个旅的兵马啊，就这样没了。
反观其他诸侯则是面色如常，战争死这么多人对他们来说仿佛是家常便饭，毕竟之前基本上都是参加过黄巾之乱的人，那时面对的死亡人数更多，对于战争来说，人命如草芥。
“传令，明日继续攻关！”袁绍斩钉截铁的说道。
“将军，我看您面色有些不好。”回去的路上，曹性关心道。

“没事，看并州儿郎死在城下，心里有些不好受。”
“将军爱兵如子，可精锐之师就是一场场战斗而来的，想我们并州狼骑，屡次与异族交战，才有如今之战力。”高顺宽慰道。
“唉，的确如此啊！可看着他们就在我的面前倒下，心中不甘。”吕布叹道。
“传令各部，死者做好登记，伤者做好治疗，今晚加强戒备，防止敌军袭营。”
“诺！”曹性高顺抱拳道，经过吕布多次夜间训练的并州军，夜晚的防守十分严密，这也是当晚华雄夜袭，没有在并州军身上占到便宜的原因。
月明星稀，各路诸侯营寨戒备森严，诸侯没有庸才，这个时候损兵折将，对战后论功行赏来讲十分不利，孙坚号称江东猛虎，在汜水关外损兵折将之后，在诸侯之中的话语权也变小了。
“将军，营外有一人自称将军故人求见。”

content_en:
"Alliance leader, Lu Bu has been provoking outside the pass all day long, but he has no intention of making progress. I heard that he entertains various princes and generals every night. I'm afraid he doesn't want to attack the pass." In the tent of the princes, Yuan Shu did not forget to give Lu Bu eye drops in front of him.
"Hmph, Sishui Pass is easy to defend but difficult to attack. The defense equipment in the pass is excellent. Attacking by force is tantamount to death. Our army's morale is low after a new defeat. General Lu has made great achievements in the battle. How can I allow you to talk nonsense." Sun Jian snorted coldly. He was now a little disappointed with the two brothers of the Yuan family. Since the alliance, the princes have only been eating and drinking together without thinking about progress.
"General Lu's contribution to killing General Dong is indispensable." Gongsun Zan also echoed.
"All generals listen to the order, prepare troops and horses, and attack Sishui Pass as soon as possible. We will not give up until this pass is broken." Yuan Shao made up his mind and said that sending Lu Bu up was also to consume the strength of the Bingzhou Army. Dong Zhuo's move will definitely frighten the princes. If he does not attack, he may lose the hearts of everyone.
"No." All the princes said in unison.
Three days later, Yuan Jun was covered in silk cloth, and Yuan Shao waved his hand, "Kill!"
The rumbling drums stimulated the heart of every coalition soldier, and the fear of facing the great pass and unknown death seemed to dissipate in the drums.
As the messengers passed down the orders one after another, the coalition forces of more than 100,000 princes were put into action. The ladders were carried by the soldiers and they rushed towards the city wall. Facing the arrows like locusts, human life was so worthless. Most of the soldiers fell forever on the way forward.
The injured soldiers were unable to retreat at all. Their wailing sounds were so faint on the huge battlefield. They could only watch helplessly as the soldiers swarmed from behind and fell helplessly into the sea of ​​people.
Lu Bu, who was in the Chinese army, once again felt the cruelty of cold weapon warfare, especially in front of a majestic pass like Sishui Pass. If he wanted to break through it, he would need the blood and corpses of soldiers to pile up a passage to the pass.
This was different from the previous battle with Dong Zhuo in the wild. The defenders in the pass relied on the high walls of the city and kept shooting with bows and arrows. The wood and rolling stones poured down desperately. Many soldiers fell forever without even knowing what the enemy looked like. At this time, even the generals with strong martial arts dare not say that they would survive such an siege alone. The strength of one person is always limited.
Looking at the fallen soldiers of Bingzhou, Lu Bu felt his heart bleed. He regarded these soldiers as brothers, people he could rely on for life and death, but he did not expect that life and death could be separated in the blink of an eye.
"Alliance leader, there are 50,000 reinforcements in Sishui Pass, and the old thief Dong Zhuo is in the pass. It will be difficult to conquer for a while." Lu Bu advised.
"No need to say more, I won't give up until this level is broken!" Yuan Shao said with determination.
Most of the Allied troops were untrained soldiers. Most of them may have just put down their farm tools and picked up weapons. Facing the deaths one after another in Paoze, many people were frightened, threw away their weapons and tried to escape from this hell on earth, but what greeted them was the arrows of the supervising generals.
At the end of the day, corpses piled up like mountains in the pass, the city walls were covered with blood, and the gate of Sishui Pass was also somewhat deformed.
"Alliance leader, in today's battle, the coalition lost a total of more than 8,000 soldiers and horses, more than 4,000 people were seriously injured, and countless minor injuries were reported." After the general in charge of statistics reported the number of generals, Lu Bu took a breath. More than 8,000 people died in one day. These were the soldiers and horses of two brigades, and they were just gone.
On the other hand, the expressions of other princes were as usual. It seemed to them that so many people died in the war. After all, they were basically people who participated in the Yellow Turban Rebellion before. At that time, they faced more deaths. For war, human life is nothing.
"Send the order and continue to tackle the key problems tomorrow!" Yuan Shao said decisively.
"General, I see that you look a little bad." On the way back, Cao Xing said with concern.
"It's okay. I feel a little bad when I see Bingzhou Erlang dying under the city."
"A general loves his soldiers as much as his sons, but an elite division comes from battle after battle."Yes, I think our Bingzhou Wolf Cavalry has fought with foreign races many times, so we have the fighting power we have today. Gao Shun comforted.
"Oh, that's true! But seeing them fall down right in front of me, I felt unwilling. "Lu Bu sighed.
"Instruct all ministries to register the dead, treat the injured, and step up vigilance tonight to prevent enemy troops from attacking the camp. "
"No! "Cao Xing Gaoshun Baoquan said, the Bingzhou Army, which had been trained by Lu Bu many times at night, was very tightly defended at night. This was also the reason why Hua Xiong's night attack that night did not take advantage of the Bingzhou Army.
The moon was sparse, the princes' camps were heavily guarded, and there were no mediocre princes. Losing troops and generals at this time was very detrimental to post-war merit-based rewards. Sun Jian was known as the Tiger of the East of the Yangtze. After losing troops and generals outside Sishui Pass, his right to speak among the princes also became smaller.
"General, there is a man outside the camp who claims to be an old friend of the general and wants to see him. "
